name: Castling
strategy: Establish defensive formations, prepared firing positions, and mutually supporting strongpoints.

commands.name: Hold Formation
commands.effect: If the active Unit has not voluntarily Moved, Disengaged, Charged, or Blinked this Round, it gains Tough 2 until the end of this Combat Phase.

commands.name: Layered Defense
commands.effect: When a friendly Unit that did not voluntarily Move or Disengage during the preceding Movement Phase receives a Charge, it gains Brace 2 against that Charge's Impact pool.

commands.name: Fortified Emplacement
commands.effect: When a friendly Unit that has not voluntarily Moved or Blinked this Round is attacked at range, it gains Tough 3 against that Attack.

commands.name: Prepared Firing Lanes
commands.effect: If the active Unit has not voluntarily Moved, Disengaged, or Blinked this Round, its next ranged Attack against an enemy that Moved this Round gains Accurate 2 and +1 Attack die.

commands.name: Maintain Positions
commands.effect: Remove Withdrawn, Slow, or one temporary Hit penalty from the active Unit. If it has not voluntarily Moved or Blinked this Round, it also gains Brace 1 against the next Charge it receives this Round.

doctrineIdentity: Defensive preparation and positional advantage. Castling is more predictable than Counter Strike but requires giving up movement or anticipating an enemy's approach.
